entityImpactGraph.description: Configure defaults and performance settings for the dashboard entity impact graph.

hints.note: These settings apply to all users in the org. User-side filters still work per session.
hints.minEntityConfidence: Filters out low-confidence entities extracted from content.
hints.minCorrelation: Minimum absolute correlation (0-1) between an entity and a financial instrument.
hints.minCoOccurrence: Minimum co-occurrence count between entity pairs.
hints.maxNodes: Upper bound for returned nodes (affects chart density and performance).
hints.categories: Restrict the graph to selected categories.
hints.cacheTtlSeconds: 0 disables caching; otherwise cache results for N seconds.

knowledgeGraph.description: Configure finance knowledge graph ingestion and query caching settings.

hints.note: Enable ingestion to incrementally build the knowledge graph from processed articles.
hints.ingestionEnabled: When disabled, the cron job will not ingest new articles into the graph.
hints.seedIngestionEnabled: When disabled, structured seed sources will not be ingested into the graph.
hints.seedSwIndustriesPerRun: Max Shenwan third-level industries ingested per run.
hints.maxBatchSize: Max processed articles to ingest per run.
hints.maxRelationsPerArticle: Upper bound on relations ingested from a single article.
hints.minEdgeConfidence: Filter out relations below this confidence.
hints.dynamicEdgeConfidenceEnabled: When enabled, the effective threshold is max(minEdgeConfidence, quantile(confidence)).
hints.dynamicEdgeConfidenceQuantile: Quantile (0-1) used when computing the dynamic threshold.
hints.multiModelValidationEnabled: Validate a subset of relations with 2-3 LLM models and adjust confidence by voting.
hints.multiModelValidationModels: Optional override; leave empty to use the LLM gateway default + fallbacks.
hints.multiModelValidationMaxRelationsPerArtic: Max relations per article to validate (higher = more LLM calls).
hints.multiModelValidationDisabled: Enable multi-model validation to cross-check extracted relations and reduce false positives.
hints.entityDisambiguationEnabled: Use LLM to disambiguate entity linking when multiple candidates match.
hints.entityDisambiguationMaxCandidates: Number of candidates sent to the disambiguation prompt.
hints.cacheTtlSeconds: 0 disables caching; otherwise cache graph queries for N seconds.
